purpose: Join prepared SIDIS/SIA/STAR observables under the same 13-parameter physical family and a covariance-aware profiled Gaussian objective, as a prerequisite to the real-data fit executor.
observation_scope: The current likelihood constructor accepts explicitly synthetic observations only. Experimental candidates, historical candidates and production data are rejected. There is no real-data admission or optimizer fallback.

prediction_contract.parameters: KPSYParameters, 13 direct physical coordinates; retain the original closed bounds and unsupported singular shape derivatives
prediction_contract.settings: Fixed source/model/geometry/coupling settings only; no setting derivatives or language-model/Python callbacks
prediction_contract.ordering: Unique nonempty point identifiers; data point order must match prepared prediction order exactly
prediction_contract.STAR_point_phase: Required explicit sin_phiS_minus_phiH or sin_phiH_minus_phiS; bin plans retain their own phase and reject a second one
prediction_contract.leptonic_phase: Inherited unchanged from the prepared observable or bin; no further angular or DNN factor
prediction_contract.lattice: A separately validated full-x tensor-charge/endpoint plan is still required; do not replace it with a truncated moment or ignore an unsupported observation
prediction_contract.ownership: Own identifier/observation tuples, fixed numerical data and metadata; validate child snapshots and reject mutation of observations, covariance, nuisance settings or provenance

likelihood.covariance: C is the explicitly supplied finite symmetric positive-definite fixed data covariance; no diagonalization, clipping, inferred missing error or overlap treatment
likelihood.nuisance: A and R have the same ordered source-group columns. A is in asymmetry units, R is relative. S is the explicitly supplied symmetric positive-definite nuisance covariance; no unspecified group correlations are inferred.
likelihood.profile: Let S=L*L'. B(theta)=[A+diag(t(theta))*R]*L. Minimize (r-B*a)'*inv(C)*(r-B*a)+a'*a over a; report original nu=L*a.
likelihood.differentiation: Differentiate the complete profiled objective, including the theory dependence of B(theta). Both gradient and nested HVP remain Julia computations.
likelihood.not_marginal_likelihood: This is a nuisance-profile chi2. Do not add logdet(C+B*B') or label it a marginalized Bayesian posterior.
likelihood.historical_normalizations: No nuisance is assigned to an experimental source here. KPSY Eq116 normalization exclusion and all updated-fit polarization/normalization choices require separate reviewed data policies.
likelihood.subsets: Explicit point/process selections retain the marginal covariance submatrix, all nuisance columns and the complete nuisance prior; no block-independence assumption or conditional-on-held-out-data covariance

validation_policy.derivative_reference: Independent augmented least-squares/QR profiling in BigFloat, with central differences at both frozen steps and Richardson cancellation of the leading h^2 term for all 13 gradient coordinates and a full HVP. Retain coarse operands.
validation_policy.scope_of_fixture: Mixed prepared point/bin process contexts with explicitly synthetic source rows and observations. These test joint assembly and inference algebra, not native evolution or physical experimental admission.
controls: independent augmented QR and effective-covariance identities
correlated nuisance prior and source-column reparameterization
validation_policy.physical_inputs: A separate whole-Julia-job producer must prepare current pinned-input process contexts and repeat the joint checks. Synthetic fixtures do not certify that path.
validation_policy.status: Any absent, stale, unsupported or failed required check remains FAIL. Existing failed KPSY center benchmarks and production prerequisites are unchanged.

limitations: This component does not yet implement the real-data fitting job loader, bounded optimizer, replica fitting, inference coverage or publication products
Current physical process plans remain reconstructed and unadmitted; all acceptance, overlap, covariance, source and original-code limitations persist
No full-x lattice moment, bin acceptance, sign, matching, coupling or evolution prescription is changed
No experimental observation is silently converted to synthetic or admitted by a passed synthetic receipt
Production/extraction/G2PERF remain false; physical joint fitting and a real-data executor still require completion
